review:
Another non-interactive short animation film in VR, this one's originality comes from its vector/low-polygon aesthetics and great sense of scale.

I wouldn't call it essential, but it's good and it's free, so I see no reason to pass on this one.

Not that good, primitive graphics. Used it with Oculus Rift and it never really convinced me that I was in another world. Also didn't work with my Xbox One controller, got it working somehow by random keypresses.

WTF was all that about, bloke fishing for crabs, giant rock thing comes along, doing no harm, he kills it?? Did I miss something, not going to watch it again to find out.  If I could score it out of 10 I’d give it a 3 for being VR

バーチャルショートフィルム、映像作品
時間にして3分少々
NHKのしっとりとした短編アニメーション作品を見ているような感覚
